name: Vosh (VOxel-meSH)
definition: A hybrid representation for NeRF-based real-time view synthesis that combines voxel and mesh components. It optimizes a voxel grid based on neural rendering and strategically meshes a portion of the volumetric density field to surface. It excels in fast rendering for simple geometry/texture via the mesh component and high-quality rendering for intricate regions via the voxel component.
summary: Vosh is a hybrid neural rendering representation combining voxels and meshes for real-time mobile view synthesis, using density fields instead of SDFs to handle complex backgrounds.
